name: spec-to-roadmap
title: Spec to Roadmap Generator
description: Transform a project spec or ticket plan into a versioned roadmap with milestones, defining exactly what ships in each release.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: source_path
inputs.description: Path to the source spec or ticket plan document

inputs.name: target_path
inputs.description: Path where ROADMAP.md will be written

gates.prompt:
Read and extract structured information from a project spec.

Source: {{source_path}}

Your task:
1. Read the source document
2. Extract the complete list of features/tickets
3. Identify technical dependencies between items
4. Determine the overall project scope
5. Note existing constraints or priorities

Return JSON: { "features":[{"id":"","name":"","description":""}], "dependencies":[["id1","id2"]], "scope":"", "constraints":[] }
